tool_schemas.name: send-email
tool_schemas.description: Creates an outbound email message, expands the provided To/Cc/Bcc/Reply-To recipients into recipient records, stores the content (subject plus text_body and/or html_body), queues initial provider delivery attempts, and returns the created message identifier and initial lifecycle state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to send from the specified from_email, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds configured send-rate or quota limits. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, recipient lists are empty, any email address is malformed, headers contain non-string values, or both text_body and html_body are omitted; raises CONFLICT when an identical send request is rejected as a duplicate under the service’s idempotency/duplication rules.

from_email.description: Sender email address to use for the message.

from_name.description: Optional display name for the sender.

headers.description: Additional email headers to include with the message.

tags.description: Tags to associate with the message for tracking and filtering.

tool_schemas.name: get-auth-context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API key context for the current request, including key identity, granted scopes, and current quota / rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request. If omitted, the call is treated as unauthenticated.

tool_schemas.name: list-email-messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored email messages visible to the authenticated API key, with filtering by lifecycle status and time range. Returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

tag.description: Filter to messages containing the given tag.

provider_message_id.description: Filter by provider message identifier (if present).

created_after.description: Only include messages created at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only include messages created before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (page size).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get-email-message
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single email message by id, including its current lifecycle state and stored content fields. Raises NOT_FOUND when the message does not exist (or is not visible to the API key), UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

message_id.description: Primary identifier of the email message to fetch.

include.description: Optional related resources to include inline.

tool_schemas.name: list-email-recipients
tool_schemas.description: Lists recipients for a given message, or all recipients visible to the API key with optional filters. Returns a paginated result set. Raises NOT_FOUND when the specified message_id does not exist (or is not visible), UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

message_id.description: If provided, restrict results to recipients belonging to this message id.

email.description: Filter by recipient email address (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (page size).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: list-email-provider-attempts
tool_schemas.description: Lists provider delivery attempts for a given message, or all attempts visible to the API key with optional filters. Returns a paginated result set ordered by started_at/created_at descending. Raises NOT_FOUND when the specified message_id does not exist (or is not visible), UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

message_id.description: If provided, restrict results to attempts belonging to this message id.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (page size).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: cancel-email-message
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a queued email message by transitioning its status from queued to cancelled. Refuses cancellation if the message has already left queued state or is terminal. Returns the updated message status. Raises NOT_FOUND when the message does not exist (or is not visible), UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is revoked, and CONFLICT when the lifecycle transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

message_id.description: Primary identifier of the email message to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for audit/debugging.
